recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sun-drenched scene featuring a woman in urban summer attire squatting to wash a large, chrome-finished custom wheel of a vintage car. The car features a warm sunset gradient paint job and airbrushed script. The ground is covered in soapy suds, and a blue bucket sits in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: The woman's posture mirrors the circular curve of the oversized chrome rim.
The warm orange-to-yellow gradient of the car contrasts with the cool blue of the bucket and soapy water.
The airbrushed script on the car door follows the horizontal flow of the vehicle's body lines.
coreInvariants: Abundant white soap suds on grass/dirt

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The woman is the central figure, positioned in the lower right quadrant, scaled to occupy approximately 40% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, reflective chrome wheel in the center-left acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the woman's hands, follows the water suds down to the bucket, then moves up the chrome rim to the car's gradient and the script on the door.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is tightly packed with the car, subject, and washing equipment.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sunset tones (orange, peach, yellow) on the car body.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool blue tones in the plastic bucket and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: High-shine chrome/silver on the wheels and white for the soap suds.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the car's paint; high value/brightness in the chrome highlights and soap.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muted or desaturated earth tones
Maintain high contrast between warm car and cool suds

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with high-flourish ascenders and descenders
letterConstructionRules: Dynamic, slanted orientation following the car's body line
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended swashes on initial and terminal letters to imply speed/motion
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, fluid script integrated into the scene paired with a rigid, utilitarian block label for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the custom automotive decal look.
Standard for the advisory label aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a woman in a bikini and denim shorts squatting to wash a large chrome wheel of a vintage car with a peach-to-yellow gradient paint job. Include a blue bucket and white soap suds on the ground. Ensure the car door has a blank space for lettering.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom airbrushed script decal to the car door in a magenta-to-purple gradient with a white outline. Add a standard black and white 'Parental Advisory' style label in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the car paint a smooth sunset gradient?
Are the rims highly reflective chrome?
Is the script lettering airbrushed onto the car surface?
Is the advisory label in the correct corner?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Specific brand logos on shoes or bucket
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script follows the car's perspective
Verify the soap suds look voluminous and wet
Confirm the color balance between warm car and cool bucket
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Sunset Gradient Car] + [Custom Chrome Rims] + [Urban Summer Fashion] + [Airbrushed Script Decal] to create a high-energy hip-hop visual.
